items.title: Freeport LNG Outage Erases Nearly 5 Bcf of Natural Gas Demand in a Week
items.summary: Freeport LNG has run one train short of its usual appetite for the past week, throttling back US LNG feedgas demand by roughly 0.7 Bcf/d in an outage masked by early-cycle nominations.

items.title: Europe Must Top Record LNG Imports This Winter to Protect Storage, GIE Warns
items.summary: European buyers are expected to raise competition for US LNG this winter, as Gas Infrastructure Europe (GIE) warned the latest winter supply outlook showed volumes would have to top last winter’s record imports to keep storage from running short.

items.title: Can Natural Gas Futures Comeback Hold Onto Gains?

items.title: South Central Natural Gas Storage Injection Redirects Regional Supply Trajectory
items.summary: Natural gas stored in the South Central region grew at a healthy clip to start October, narrowing deficits relative to past years but hardly erasing concerns about supply adequacy for the coming winter.

items.title: If El Niño Is So Strong, Why Are Northeast Natural Gas Winter Prices So High?
items.summary: The prospect of a historically strong El Niño is raising questions about US natural gas heating demand this winter, but expanding LNG exports, subdued production and the potential for regional supply constraints are complicating the market outlook.

items.title: Pipeline Constraints Keep New England January Natural Gas Forwards Above $20
items.summary: New England natural gas forwards are topping $20/MMBtu for January 2027 at several key hubs, even as Henry Hub trades below $4 and expectations for ample US supplies point to a relatively comfortable winter market.

items.title: What Plunging Spot Prices Could Mean for Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: A nearly nationwide collapse in natural gas spot prices on Friday reflected light shoulder season demand, and signalled that bullish sentiment underpinning the futures market could soon erode.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Cruise to Weekly Gains as Gulf Coast Braces for Isaias
items.summary: With a powerful hurricane poised to smack the northern Gulf Coast over Columbus Day weekend, natural gas futures pushed higher on Friday to accentuate a winning week.
